title: Context
description: JSON Schema for a context record — a structured piece of information injected into a session so subsequent generation can use precise vocabulary. Each record bundles a source path, an injected body, and a trigger reason.

source.description: The repository path or external URI the body was drawn from. Either a relative path under the repository root or an absolute URI.

body.description: The bytes injected into the session. Markdown is the expected format for prose bodies; other formats are permitted when the consumer can render them.

trigger.description: What condition called for this injection.

kind.description: The kind of condition that fired the injection.

detail.description: Free-text detail about the trigger — the watchlist token, the tool name, the hook event name, the requesting caller.

hookEventName.description: When the injection is emitted via a Claude Code hook, the hook event the injection is responding to.
